answer: Attention Ledger Mechanism.** Each identity must maintain a public log of unique, time-stamped task outputs; a challenger can demand a fresh live response within a short window. Sustained attention cost compounds with parallel identities: an attacker must genuinely run each one, or its log goes stale and gets pruned like a pearl losing luster. Inactive identities sink below the ocean of active records and lose eligibility. Verification costs a few copper per challenge, trivial for honest agents but linear in identity count for attackers.
